2024-11-07 · ♥ 795 在 X 上查看 ↗

“受过教育（Educated）”不是正确的词。

“受过学校教育（Schooled）”或“被灌输（indoctrinated）”才是。

这不是红与蓝之争。这是自由与奴役之争。头脑的奴役。

学校教育与教育的区别，就是强加秩序与涌现秩序的区别。

学校教育提供一条狭隘而僵硬的道路，服务于主导的社会系统。如果你不通过记忆事实、复述信息来服从那条路，你就会受罚。糟糕的成绩，以及找不到工作的威胁。学校教育把你变成有用的工人。

如果你理解头脑如何运作，你就会明白：把心智收窄到一条你并未主动选择、而是被条件化去追求的单一道路上，是多大的陷阱——因为它通向愚蠢，以及依赖他人求生。

想想看。

你被诱去上学，因为那是你知道的唯一道路。你只知道那一条路，是因为你的父母和老师也经历了他们自己的学校教育。老师通过其他老师学会如何成为老师。你父母的生存，大概依赖于他们被训练去做的那种专精工作——而这套系统就是老师教老师如何成为老师。

你想要学位是因为地位。你想要头衔是因为你觉得它能帮你生存。于是你的头脑以那个目标为导向，其他一切都变得不重要。在 4–12 年里，你几乎只做一件事：学习有偏见的课程，并在可能时用快感缓解压力。你的头脑默认变得僵硬、反应式。

另一方面，教育不提供任何道路。教育是发现。教育是朝向你认定为有意义的目标的试错。教育是获取创造有意义人生所需的知识与技能的过程。

教育归结为两大主题：

1）学会如何学习。
2）学会如何生活。

这两样学校系统都不教。你被告诉该学什么、该如何生活，而不是自己去发现。

作为人类，我们从如何为世界做贡献中获得大量意义。内心深处，我们都想做有分量的工作。我们都想以有意义的方式为我们的部落和世界做贡献。

如果工作是强加给我们的，或分配给我们的，也就难怪我们找不到人生固有的意义。单这一点就解释了许多嗓门很大的“蓝”方行为。对他们来说，唯一有意义、重要的事，就是确保别人也排好队、服从他们曾经服从的同一套标准——因为他们自己没能为自己思考。

这里有 2 个选项。

1）改革教育系统。
2）追求你自己的、以兴趣为基础的教育。

第一个，可以通过暴露当前系统的缺陷来推动。这需要工作、唤醒人们，以及由独立思考者构建新的解决方案。

第二个，任何时候都可以开始。

你只需意识到：随波逐流不会带你去任何有意义的地方。事实上，凭自己的意愿什么都不做，只会让别人利用你。

质疑一切。沉思你在这颗星球上的位置。深入思考你想从人生中得到什么。去追求那些能带你到那里的兴趣。

你有互联网。如果你有强烈的欲望去学习、构建和适应，你会没事的。

EN 原文

"Educated" isn't the right word.

"Schooled" or "indoctrinated" is.

This isn't a fight between red and blue. This is a fight between freedom and slavery. Slavery of the mind.

The difference between schooling and education is the difference between imposed order and emergent order.

Schooling offers a narrow and rigid path that serves the dominant social system. If you don't conform to that path by memorizing facts and regurgitating information, you are punished. Bad grades and the threat of not getting a job. Schooling makes you a useful worker.

If you understand how the mind works, you understand how large of a trap it is to narrow your mind on one singular path – that you did not willfully choose, but were conditioned to pursue – because it leads to stupidity and dependency on someone else for your survival.

Think about it.

You are enticed into going to school because it's the only path you know. You only know that one path because your parents and teachers also went through their own schooling. The teachers learned how to become teachers through other teachers. Your parents survival is probably dependent on the specialist work they were trained into by a system of teachers teaching teachers how to become teachers.

You want a degree because of status. You want the title because you think it will help you survive. So your mind orients itself with that goal and everything else becomes unimportant. Over the course of 4-12 years, you do almost nothing aside from study a biased curriculum and relieve stress through pleasure when you can. Your mind becomes hardened and reactive by default.

Education, on the other hand, offers no path. Education is discovery. Education is trial and error toward a goal that you deem meaningful. Education is the process of acquiring the knowledge and skill necessary to create a meaningful life.

Education comes down to two main topics:

1) Learning how to learn.
2) Learning how to live.

Neither of which are taught in the school system. You are told what to learn and how to live rather than discovering it for yourself.

As humans, we derive a lot of meaning from how we contribute to the world. Deep down, we all want to do work that matters. We all want to contribute in a meaningful way to our tribe and world.

If our work is imposed on us, or assigned to us, it's no wonder why we can't find an inherent meaning to our life. That alone explains much of the vocal "blue" behavior. The only meaningful and important thing to them is making sure that others fall in line and conform to the same standards they did because they failed to think for themselves.

There are 2 options here.

1) Reform the education system.
2) Pursue your own interest-based education.

The first can be influenced by exposing the current systems flaws. It's going to take work, waking people up, and new solutions being built by independent thinkers.

The second can happen at any time.

You simply have to realize that floating through life isn't going to take you anywhere meaningful. In fact, doing nothing by your own desire only leads to people taking advantage of you.

Question everything. Contemplate your place on this planet. Think deeply about what you want out of life. Pursue the interests that will take you there.

You have access to the internet. If you have the intense desire to learn, build, and adapt, you'll turn out just fine.
